rules.quote: Some words are always followed by particular prepositions.
rules.specification: Check conventional word–preposition combinations. The page explicitly accepts ‘different to’ and ‘different from’, rejects ‘different than’, and contrasts ‘discussion about’ with ‘discussion around’. A broader checker would need a reviewed inventory of acceptable combinations and their senses.
rules.violation_condition: A word is paired with a preposition that is inappropriate for that word and its intended meaning, such as ‘different than’ or ‘discussion around’ when referring to the subject of a discussion.
when: Applies when a word takes a preposition in the sense being used.
Do not flag a word merely because it has no following preposition.
rules.why: G-2 consolidates word-specific cases into one compatibility check; G-4 avoids separately marking the heading and its restatement.
